adjudication: The positive mean and bootstrap lower bound are descriptive evidence. The preregistered intersection rule also required sign-flip p <= 0.05, so the absolute-effect criterion remains failed.

day_cluster_bootstrap.day_weighting: days are sampled as clusters; event counts per sampled day carry through
day_cluster_bootstrap.null_or_target: uncertainty interval for the mean under day-resampled clusters
day_cluster_bootstrap.sensitivity: can give a positive interval when day-level means are mostly positive

sign_flip_permutation.null_or_target: symmetry or exchangeability of signs around zero
sign_flip_permutation.resampling_unit: event signs with fixed magnitudes in the frozen implementation
sign_flip_permutation.sensitivity: skew, heavy tails, and within-day dependence can raise p-values
